items.name: whole almonds (raw, skin-on)
items.preparation: raw or dry-roasted whole almonds, unsalted in appearance, no visible oil

scale_cues: Square white plate (assumed ~22-25 cm side) on a scale tray; mass estimated mainly by counting about 40-50 almonds, partly piled, at about 1.2 g each.
assumptions: Almonds are plain (raw or dry-roasted) with no added oil, salt or coating
Average almond mass about 1.2 g; a few almonds are hidden in the pile
Nutrition at about 579 kcal and 21 g protein per 100 g
A few almonds look chipped or broken but all are counted as edible
